name: Caustic Shells
source:
The year is 2006.

NASCAR is a sport where stock car drivers race around a series of oval tracks at speeds of up to 200mph.

NASCAR is a colorful avenue for large corporations to advertise their goods and services for the general US populace.

NASCAR is a spectacle of destruction.

A queer quasi-mecha kinetic novel about NASCAR and three of its drivers.

[From [url=https://23noko.itch.io/caustic-shells]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
时间来到2006年。

NASCAR是一项改装赛车手在椭圆形赛道上以高达200英里的时速疾驰竞速的运动。

NASCAR是一条五彩斑斓的商业大道，供各大企业向美国大众推销自家的商品与服务。

NASCAR是一场毁灭的奇观。

这是一部围绕NASCAR及其三名车手展开的酷儿类机甲题材线性视觉小说。

[摘自[url=https://23noko.itch.io/caustic-shells]itch.io[/url]]
